disposition.confidence_reason: No unique invariant remains for a successor. CA-R-1979@16 defines the optional Confidence group, its two permitted threshold children, and inherited int format. The pinned CA-R-2624 and CA-R-2625 previews add the only unique semantics in CA-R-2271: present values are integer-percentage overrides and absence uses the governed default. CA-R-1652@41 and CA-R-380@44 remain the default authorities; CA-D-368@29 and CA-D-369@28 remain their serialization rules.
atomic_model_disposition: Adopt the pinned CA-R-2624 and CA-R-2625 integer-percentage clarifications, preserving their optional single-value cardinality, inherited int format, existing threshold meaning, and no added numeric range.
Retire CA-R-2271@3 with its exact archive and preserve all frozen CA-R-2271@version references. Do not create a new-ID confidence Rule.

Retire CA-D-372@27 and CA-D-373@25 with their exact archives as deferred field-specific Tool/Extension selection serialization decisions. Preserve all frozen @version references. No universal Tool or Extension selection model is proposed.
disposition.atomicity_guard: Keep the two threshold clarifications and retirement of the mixed CA-R-2271 source together. Retire CA-D-372/373 only in the same coordinated application that removes CA-R-2271's selection fields and references; leave CA-D-368/369 unchanged.
